title: Daily Life 2 · Food, Cooking & Eating Out
description: Từ vựng về món ăn, nấu nướng và gọi món ở nhà hàng (CEFR A1–B1). Dùng khi đi ăn với đồng nghiệp nước ngoài, đọc công thức hoặc giới thiệu món Việt.

cards.question: recipe
cards.explanation:
I followed my mom's recipe for fish sauce.
→ Tôi làm theo công thức nước mắm của mẹ.

cards.question: ingredient
cards.explanation:
Fresh ingredients make the dish taste better.
→ Nguyên liệu tươi giúp món ăn ngon hơn.

cards.question: chop
cards.explanation:
Chop the onions into small pieces.
→ Thái hành thành miếng nhỏ.

cards.question: slice
cards.explanation:
Slice the beef thinly for pho.
→ Thái thịt bò thật mỏng để nấu phở.

cards.question: peel
cards.explanation:
Peel the potatoes before boiling them.
→ Gọt vỏ khoai tây trước khi luộc.

cards.question: boil
cards.explanation:
Boil the eggs for seven minutes.
→ Luộc trứng bảy phút.

cards.question: fry
cards.explanation:
She fried the spring rolls until golden.
→ Cô ấy chiên nem đến khi vàng.

cards.question: stir-fry
cards.explanation:
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic.
→ Xào rau với tỏi.

cards.question: steam
cards.explanation:
Steamed fish is healthy and tasty.
→ Cá hấp vừa lành mạnh vừa ngon.

cards.question: grill
cards.explanation:
We grilled pork for bun cha.
→ Chúng tôi nướng thịt lợn để làm bún chả.

cards.question: bake
cards.explanation:
My sister bakes bread every weekend.
→ Chị tôi nướng bánh mì mỗi cuối tuần.

cards.question: simmer
cards.explanation:
Let the broth simmer for six hours.
→ Để nước dùng ninh liu riu sáu tiếng.

cards.question: season
cards.explanation:
Season the soup with salt and pepper.
→ Nêm súp với muối và tiêu.

cards.question: marinate
cards.explanation:
Marinate the chicken overnight.
→ Ướp gà qua đêm.

cards.question: spicy
cards.explanation:
Is this dish very spicy?
→ Món này có cay lắm không?

cards.question: salty
cards.explanation:
The soup is a bit too salty.
→ Súp hơi mặn quá.

cards.question: sour
cards.explanation:
Tamarind gives the soup a sour taste.
→ Me làm cho canh có vị chua.

cards.question: bitter
cards.explanation:
Bitter melon is good for your health.
→ Mướp đắng tốt cho sức khoẻ.

cards.question: bland
cards.explanation:
Hospital food is usually bland.
→ Đồ ăn bệnh viện thường nhạt nhẽo.

cards.question: greasy
cards.explanation:
I avoid greasy food at night.
→ Tôi tránh đồ nhiều dầu mỡ vào buổi tối.

cards.question: crispy
cards.explanation:
The skin of the roast pork is very crispy.
→ Da heo quay rất giòn.

cards.question: tender
cards.explanation:
The beef is so tender it melts in your mouth.
→ Thịt bò mềm đến mức tan trong miệng.

cards.question: leftovers
cards.explanation:
I'll take the leftovers for lunch tomorrow.
→ Tôi sẽ mang đồ ăn thừa làm bữa trưa mai.

cards.question: appetizer
cards.explanation:
Let's order some appetizers to share.
→ Gọi vài món khai vị ăn chung nhé.

cards.question: main course
cards.explanation:
For the main course, I'll have grilled fish.
→ Món chính tôi gọi cá nướng.

cards.question: dessert
cards.explanation:
Save some room for dessert!
→ Chừa bụng cho món tráng miệng nhé!

cards.question: menu
cards.explanation:
Could we see the menu, please?
→ Cho chúng tôi xem thực đơn được không?

cards.question: order
cards.explanation:
Are you ready to order?
→ Anh chị gọi món chưa ạ?

cards.question: book a table
cards.explanation:
I booked a table for six at 7 p.m.
→ Tôi đã đặt bàn cho sáu người lúc 7 giờ tối.

cards.question: the bill
cards.explanation:
Could we have the bill, please?
→ Cho chúng tôi xin hoá đơn.

cards.question: split the bill
cards.explanation:
Let's split the bill equally.
→ Mình chia đều tiền nhé.

cards.question: my treat
cards.explanation:
Put your wallet away, it's my treat.
→ Cất ví đi, để tôi mời.

cards.question: tip
cards.explanation:
Tips are not expected in most Vietnamese restaurants.
→ Ở phần lớn nhà hàng Việt, khách không cần boa.

cards.question: takeaway
cards.explanation:
Let's get a takeaway tonight; I'm too tired to cook.
→ Tối nay mua đồ mang về đi, mình mệt quá không nấu nổi.

cards.question: food delivery
cards.explanation:
Food delivery apps are very popular in Vietnam.
→ Ứng dụng giao đồ ăn rất phổ biến ở Việt Nam.

cards.question: street food
cards.explanation:
Hanoi is famous for its street food.
→ Hà Nội nổi tiếng với đồ ăn đường phố.

cards.question: vegetarian
cards.explanation:
Do you have any vegetarian dishes?
→ Ở đây có món chay không?

cards.question: allergic to
cards.explanation:
I'm allergic to shrimp.
→ Tôi bị dị ứng tôm.

cards.question: starving
cards.explanation:
I skipped lunch, so I'm starving.
→ Tôi bỏ bữa trưa nên giờ đói meo.

cards.question: full
cards.explanation:
No more, thanks, I'm full.
→ Thôi, cảm ơn, tôi no rồi.

cards.question: delicious
cards.explanation:
This bowl of bun bo is delicious.
→ Tô bún bò này ngon thật.

cards.question: home-cooked
cards.explanation:
Nothing beats a home-cooked meal.
→ Không gì bằng bữa cơm nhà.

cards.question: fish sauce
cards.explanation:
Fish sauce is the soul of Vietnamese cooking.
→ Nước mắm là linh hồn của ẩm thực Việt.
